sidebar.guestCta: MindX student? Sign in to save jobs and apply.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Sign in to save jobs you like and manage your applications.
login.demoHint: SS team accounts are created by an admin on the backend — they use this same sign-in form.

register.title: Create an account
register.lede: Create an account to save jobs you like and track opportunities that fit you.
register.demoHint: After signing up, check your email and click the verification link before you can sign in.
register.successMessage: Sign-up successful — check your email to verify your account before signing in.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.lede: Enter your registered email and we'll send a password reset link (expires in 1 hour).
forgotPassword.error: Couldn't send the password reset email
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent to it.

resetPassword.invalidLede: Missing token in the link — please use the exact link from your email, or request a new one.
resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.lede: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.error: Couldn't reset password — the link may have expired or already been used.
resetPassword.successMessage: Password reset successful — please sign in again with your new password.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.lede: Your account is using a temporary password — please set a new password before continuing to use the system.
changePassword.oldPasswordLabel: Current password (leave blank if it's a temporary password)

success.title: Verification successful
success.message: Your account has been activated — you can now sign in to save jobs and apply.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.message: Verification links are only valid for 24 hours. Please sign in to request a new verification email.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.message: This link is incorrect or has already been used. Please check your email again or sign up again.

default.title: Verify email
default.message: No verification status was provided — please use the exact link from your email.
